title: Siege of Lahore (1761)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Lahore (1761)", at revision 1370742764, opens: "The siege of Lahore took place in 1761 when the Sikhs besieged Lahore and captured it after facing no opposition from Durrani forces." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q48724669, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Sikh capture of Lahore, Punjab from the Durrani Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
